units.source_text: 鹤川并没有用高兴的眼光来看待我和柏木的交往。

en.t: Tsurukawa did not look happily upon my association with Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 他曾充满友情地向我忠告，可我却感到厌烦。

en.t: He once warned me out of friendship, but I only found it annoying.

units.source_text: 不仅如此，还同他争辩，我说：

en.t: Not only that, I even argued with him and said:

units.source_text: 鹤川你有可能获得好朋友，而对我来说，柏木与我的相交是十分相称的。

en.t: Tsurukawa, you may be able to find good friends, but for me, associating with Kashiwagi suits me perfectly.

units.source_text: 当时鹤川眼里浮现出无以名状的悲伤的神色。

en.t: At that moment, an indescribably sorrowful look appeared in Tsurukawa's eyes.

units.source_text: 很久以后，每次我回忆起他的这种悲伤的神色，心头就涌上一股强烈的悔恨起。

en.t: Long afterward, whenever I remembered that sorrowful look of his, a powerful remorse would well up in my heart.
